newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Zhejiang Expressway says IPO 118 times subscribed.
newsitem.headline: Zhejiang Expressway says IPO 118 times subscribed.

text.p: China's Zhejiang Expressway Co Ltd said on Tuesday its initial public offering of 124.68 million H-shares in Hong Kong was 118 times subscribed.
The Chinese toll road operator said the new issue price had been set at HK$2.38 each.

The offering initially involved the issue of 124.68 million new H-shares in a Hong Kong public initial offering, and a placement of 1.12 billion H-shares to U.S. and international investors at between HK$2.06 and HK$2.38 per share.
Zhejiang Expressway said an additional 305.47 million H-shares had been reallocated from the international placement to the new issue, raising the new issue to 430.16 million shares.
Dealing in the H-shares, or Chinese state-owned enterprises listed in Hong Kong, is due to begin on May 15.
